description: AnyMOD Example Model (AnyMOD_example_model) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by not stated on the factsheet. An example model created with the AnyMOD framework. Its purpose is to demonstrate how models, their input data, and their results can be made open and accessible with AnyMOD. In addition, the repository can serve as an example for version controlled model development using AnyMOD. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: Optimization. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
